gaps: three channels, or more than four, are refused by Web Audio; the bridge keeps the previous response (X_ITE throws)
the response is built at the audio context's own sample rate, as in X_ITE; the processed sound is not compared
numberOfChannels is a Convolver field in X_ITE 16.6.0 but is not in the X3D 4.0 UOM or XSD; the bridge has it as in X_ITE (set at run time only, since the XSD cannot write it)
